description_en: Modifies the specifications and storage space of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于变更实例的规格和存储空间
name: ScaleInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Hologres instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The low-frequency storage space of the instance. Unit: GB.

This parameter is ignored for pay-as-you-go instances
parameters.help_zh:
实例低频存储空间。单位：GB。

按量付费（PostPaid）实例会忽略此参数
parameters.name: cold_storage_size

parameters.help_en:
The instance specifications. Valid values:
16 cores and 64 GB (number of compute nodes: 1)
32 cores and 128 GB (number of compute nodes: 2)
64 cores and 256 GB (number of compute nodes: 4)
96 cores and 384 GB (number of compute nodes: 6)
128 cores and 512 GB (number of compute nodes: 8)
and more


Specify the number of cores.
To purchase specifications with more than 1,024 cores, submit a ticket.
You do not need to specify specifications for shared instances
parameters.help_zh:
实例规格。取值：
16核64 GB （计算节点数量：1）
32核128 GB（计算节点数量：2）
64核256 GB（计算节点数量：4）
96核384 GB（计算节点数量：6）
128核512 GB（计算节点数量：8）
等


填写核数即可。
购买1024以上规格请提交工单申请。
Shared实例类型无需指定规格
parameters.name: cpu

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable serverless computing
parameters.name: enable_serverless_computing

parameters.help_en:
The number of gateways. Valid values: 2 to 50.

This parameter is required only for warehouse instances
parameters.help_zh:
网关数量，取值[2, 50]。

只有Warehouse类型需要指定该参数
parameters.name: gateway_count

parameters.help_en:
The modification type. Valid values:
UPGRADE: upgrades the specifications.
DOWNGRADE: downgrades the specifications.

When you upgrade specifications, the new specifications cannot be lower than the original specifications. Empty fields indicate that the original specifications remain unchanged. At least one specification must be higher than the original specification.
When you downgrade specifications, the new specifications cannot be higher than the original specifications. Empty fields indicate that the original specifications remain unchanged. At least one specification must be lower than the original specification
parameters.help_zh:
变配类型。取值：
UPGRADE：升配
DOWNGRADE：降配

升配规格不能小于原规格，为空的字段表示维持原规格不变，在此基础上，至少一项规格比原规格大。
降配规格不能大于原规格，为空的字段表示维持原规格不变，在此基础上，至少一项规格比原规格小
parameters.name: scale_type

parameters.help_en:
The standard storage space of the instance. Unit: GB.

This parameter is ignored for pay-as-you-go instances
parameters.help_zh:
实例标准存储空间。单位：GB。

按量付费（PostPaid）实例会忽略此参数
parameters.name: storage_size

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the modification was successful
